findings.body:
chunk 1/3:

The required close run failed on Windows because `cmd.exe` interprets `NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1` as a command rather than an environment assignment. This prevents the repository's build, typecheck, and hermetic close sequence from completing on the supplied review platform. Set the variable through a cross-platform mechanism or invoke Next without POSIX-only assignment syntax.
findings.title: Make the frontend build command portable to Windows

findings.body:
chunk 1/3:

This file is outside the five paths permitted for LEGACY-UI and is not needed to provide the Playwright setup or baseline test. It also commits stale workflow state declaring the task blocked/fixing. Exclude this generated review metadata from the branch.
findings.title: Remove the out-of-scope task-state artifact

findings.body:
chunk 3/3:

The negative-control test changes only `WAREHOUSE_DRIVER`; it does not exercise altered `WAREHOUSE_PG_HOST`, `WAREHOUSE_PG_PORT`, `WAREHOUSE_PG_DATABASE`, `PGHOST`, `PGPORT`, `PGDATABASE`, `LLM_PROVIDER`, or `AUTH_OTP_MOCK`. Relaxing any corresponding guard in `playwright.config.ts` would therefore leave this safety test green even though the generated browser path can perform ingestion writes or contact an external provider. Exercise every safety-critical setting through `configExit` and verify refusal before servers or writes start.
findings.title: Not done: unsafe browser-proof destinations and providers are rejected

findings.body:
chunk 3/3:

The required close run fails during `npm run structural` because Windows `cmd.exe` interprets `NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1` as an executable name rather than an environment assignment. Consequently this branch cannot pass its repository build gate on the supplied Windows runner. Set the variable through a cross-platform mechanism or remove the inline POSIX assignment.
findings.title: Make the frontend build command portable to Windows
